sources: sec edgar submissions api, 8-K item 2.02 acceptance times

event_plausibility.reason: an event 10 days after the last print does not fit a 82-day cadence; the calendar row may be stale

deadband_basis: half the median of 8 prior reactions, floored at 1.5%
deadband_note: A realised move inside this band is scored as no-direction rather than as a miss.
expected_move_basis: median historical reaction (no usable option chain)

baseline_quality.note: thin means there is no reliable statement of what the market priced, so a confident call on this name cannot be justified by the baseline.
baseline_quality.history_discount_note: reaction history is present but not counted toward the tier: the event date does not fit this company's own filing cadence, so the history may describe a reporting regime it no longer follows
